# Hypecia Connect Services Pvt Ltd
> [https://hypeciaconnect.com](https://hypeciaconnect.com)

Hypecia Connect is a B2B infrastructure solutions company based in India, delivering carrier-grade telecom networks, AI-powered security and surveillance systems, green energy (solar) integration, industrial automation, and MEP engineering services.

## Company Facts
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: India
- Industry: Infrastructure, Telecom, Energy, Industrial Automation
- Key Client: Bharti Airtel (tier-1 telecom operator)

## Services
- [Telecom & IT Infrastructure](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Fiber optic networks, network equipment installation, data center cabling
- [Security & Surveillance](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): AI-powered CCTV, access control, biometric systems
- [Green Energy Solutions](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Solar panel installation, energy audits, sustainable infrastructure
- [Industrial Automation](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): PLC/SCADA systems, smart factory solutions
- [MEP Engineering](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing for commercial/industrial projects
- [ELV Systems](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Fire alarms, PA systems, structured cabling
- [Civil & Earthing Works](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Earthing solutions, civil construction
- [Manpower & Facility Services](https://hypeciaconnect.com/services): Skilled workforce deployment, facility management

## Notable Projects
- Deployed 2,400+ AI-enabled cameras across 157 Airtel MSC and TNG sites in Uttar Pradesh & Bihar
- Achieved 40% security improvement, 95% uptime, and 100% TRAI compliance
- End-to-end project management from site survey to commissioning
